snippet.title: Don't Go Live - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You play as a livestreamer doing urbex in abandoned locations.
Your real Twitch chat is integrated into the game.
The more your audience reacts, the more dangerous it gets.

Wishlist now on Steam! Demo out April 29

---

Don't Go Live is a first-person paranormal horror game where you film abandoned locations live for your audience. Viewer messages, emotes and spam trigger real-time in-game events. Something is watching. And your chat is helping it find you.

FEATURES
- Real Twitch chat integration: audience messages trigger in-game events
- Reactive found footage camera: glitches and distorts near paranormal anomalies
- Paranormal scanner: reveal what the naked eye can't see
- Behavioral AI entity: reacts to sound, light and stream activity
- Demo: one location, one entity, one complete gameplay loop

---

Developed by Lake On Fire
